limits: Scanning seven sources is not exhaustive across all PCC papers, conference abstracts, theses, local historical MATLAB/Python experiments, collaborators or alternate dataset aliases.
2012 TKDE source is a 2009-dated author preprint and final publisher PDF may differ; record the inspected source, not an authenticated journal PDF.
Some studies examine synthetic graphs and 2026 uses native graph datasets; absent tabular names there is not evidence of globally unused datasets.
Published tables are historical exposure evidence, not control of private archives or a scientific recommendation of a fixed 3-domain shortlist.
PDF pages were opened/screenshot-checked in web viewing; 2026 arXiv was read as HTML and not treated as PDF-verified text.
Additional journal, conference and thesis corpus not reviewed; independent ethics/group identifiers remain unresolved.
